exact_head_ci.note: This result applies to 003e65e only. The new relationship-graph documentation commit requires its own exact-head CI.

ripple_circle.relationship: Direct product/technology partnership: Circle-issued USDC launched natively on XRPL; Ripple says it intends to use USDC alongside RLUSD in Ripple Payments.
ripple_circle.implications: USDC can trade on XRPL DEX/auto-bridging, where XRP may serve as bridge asset. No evidence in this record that most USDC flows actually route through XRP.
ripple_circle.caveat: Circle remains USDC issuer; Ripple does not own USDC.

coinbase_circle.relationship: Coinbase took an equity stake in Circle and the companies retained a commercial USDC revenue-sharing arrangement. Circle remains the USDC issuer.
coinbase_circle.caveat: Equity percentage and exact contract economics are not specified in the cited public announcement.

ripple_sbi.relationship: SBI Holdings said it invested in Ripple in 2016, was its largest external shareholder, and held approximately 9% as of the June 9, 2025 release; SBI Ripple Asia is a joint venture.
ripple_sbi.caveat: Approximately 9% is a dated company disclosure, not a verified current cap table.

circle_sbi.relationship: SBI Holdings and Circle formed a 50/50 SBI Circle Holdings joint venture; SBI Holdings and SBI Shinsei Bank acquired $25M each of Circle shares at IPO ($50M total); SBI VC Trade distributed USDC; SBI Group joined Arc's founding validator cohort and a consolidated subsidiary participated in the ARC token presale.
circle_sbi.caveat: SBI's ARC presale allocation amount is undisclosed; the $222M figure is the total consortium raise, not SBI's contribution.

circle_arc.relationship: Circle Arc public mainnet launched 2026-09-16. SBI Group is a founding validator and says it will participate in operation/governance. Arc is a separate L1 with a permissioned validator set, USDC gas, Circle Payments Network/StableFX integrations and day-one markets including USYC, BUIDL, private-credit funds and cirBTC.
circle_arc.caveat: The launch asset/collateral list does not name XRP or RLUSD. No XRP collateral or XRP settlement on Arc is verified. This is a parallel/possibly competing stablecoin rail, not proof of direct displacement.

coinbase_ripple.relationship: Coinbase added RLUSD across Prime, Exchange and retail; Global Exchange collateral support was announced as a future rollout.
coinbase_ripple.caveat: No live RLUSD collateral use or XRP flow is established by the launch announcement.

bny_circle_ripple.relationship: Circle's Reserve Fund is managed by BlackRock and custodied at BNY. BNY is also Ripple's primary RLUSD reserve custodian and supports XRP/RLUSD custody and Ripple Prime custody.
bny_circle_ripple.caveat: Custody/reserve roles do not establish net XRP purchases, settlement flows or balance-sheet exposure to XRP.

standard_chartered_circle_ripple.relationship: Standard Chartered is an Arc founding validator and offers RLUSD custody on XRPL; its collateral integration with Ripple and LMAX was announced as planned.
standard_chartered_circle_ripple.caveat: The planned collateral link is not evidence that XRP or RLUSD is already accepted as collateral in that integration.

sbi_stablecoin_and_payments.usdc_vctrade_network: Ethereum only for deposits; no XRPL USDC deposit support in VCTRADE.
sbi_stablecoin_and_payments.rlusd_vctrade_network: Ethereum only for deposits/withdrawals; no XRPL RLUSD deposit support in VCTRADE.

merchant_pilot.flow: User wallet USDC -> SBI VC Trade conversion to JPY -> Aplus remits JPY to participating merchant.
merchant_pilot.limitation: The pilot release does not specify the blockchain network; it is a USDC-funded/Japanese-yen-settled pilot, not XRP or XRPL settlement.

jpy_sc.status: Initially available only inside SBI VC Trade accounts; public-chain distribution was conditional on legal/tax matters being resolved.

xrpl_fi.update_label: Updated moments ago; no exact publisher timestamp
xrpl_fi.note: Dashboard says supply/holders/24h volume are read live from XRPL, prices are curated pegs; not affiliated with Ripple or XRPL Foundation.

stable_radar.note: On-chain reads via gateway_balances/totalSupply; older than xrpl.fi capture.

circle_global_usdc.note: 3.7M XRPL USDC is approximately 0.0054% of 67.9B global USDC; cross-time and metric definitions mean this is a scale comparison, not a synchronized flow.

disagreement.issue: XRPL RLUSD supply differs across dashboards: xrpl.fi 697M at capture vs StableRadar 754.15M at Nov 13 12:43 UTC; XRPL-Utilities search result showed 907.26M in a separately crawled, older page.
disagreement.interpretation: Do not average. Resolve with direct issuer gateway_balances and transaction-history snapshots at identical ledger indices, including issuer return/burn and chain-transfer transactions.

rlusd_supply_event_candidate.reported_behavior: One wallet reportedly sent 12 large returns to the issuer; prior month-end XRPL supply drops in 2026 often rebounded, but the Oct 30 event was larger and no issuer explanation was found.
rlusd_supply_event_candidate.caveat: Returning RLUSD to issuer reduces ledger obligations; it does not prove USD redemption. Could reflect inventory return, redemption, treasury management or cross-chain rebalancing.

hypotheses.h1_xrpl_utility: USDC and RLUSD on XRPL, native DEX/auto-bridging and RWA collateral can increase ledger utility and potentially XRP bridge use; this requires observed XRP-routed trade/settlement volume.
hypotheses.h2_no_xrp_value_capture: Stablecoins can transfer or settle directly without XRP; more stablecoin supply on XRPL does not automatically imply material XRP demand.
hypotheses.h3_arc_competition: Circle Arc's USDC-gas, permissioned institutional validator and tokenized-collateral design may capture flows without XRP; this is a competing-rail hypothesis, not proven displacement.
hypotheses.h4_sbi_multi_rail: SBI's direct Ripple equity/JV and Circle JV/investment/Arc validator roles indicate a multi-rail strategy rather than exclusive commitment to XRP.
hypotheses.h5_supply_rebalancing: RLUSD XRPL supply contractions may be routine month-end treasury/chain rebalancing rather than demand destruction; transaction-level reproduction is required.

source_independence: Corporate announcements are first-party for each issuer's own agreements; market/ledger dashboards are independent analytics providers but may share the same public ledger data. No source independence claim is made where data lineage is not known.
